answer_1.quote: We prompt Llama-3.1 8B-Instruct to summarize the dialogue context, focusing on information indicative of errors in the last agent utterance... We prompt the model to generate definitions for newly discovered errors.
answer_1.outputs: dialogue summaries, error type definitions, error classification labels

answer_2.quote: We use FineSurE with DeepSeek-R1 14B and measure Faithfulness, Completeness, and Conciseness. Evaluation metrics also include H-Score, Acc-K, Acc-U, ARI, and NMI for detection performance.

answer_4.quote: We perform a manual analysis to evaluate the alignment of generated definitions with ground truth definitions.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators compare each generated error definition to the ground‑truth definition and judge how well it captures the error type.
